versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "认知工具箱 (Cognitive Tools)" skill, featuring 11 distinct AI cognitive tools distilled from seven classic books.
- Enables users to activate tools like 逻辑之刃, 问题之锤, 抽象之梯, and others using simple trigger words for in-depth analysis, concept definition, multi-angle perspectives, and more.
- Supports both single-tool invocation and recommended toolchain workflows to address complex problems systematically.
- Incorporates original prompts by 李继刚 for each cognitive tool; seamlessly integrates with other skills and requires no external API.
